book.name: John
book.title: John ka Te Pabe'e Jesus Te Naa Tooa'a-witu Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Soo nana Lazarus mee naneadu ka oona Bethany mee naneadu-kwi nobe-ga'yoo unu tuoeya'e. Lazarus ka umu tu susuakwumu Mary

noko Martha mee nananeadu-no ka Te Pabe'e-no besa nanapua'a. Mu oo susuakwamu yise ka pumme tummatzidu ka Te Pabe'e-matoo taya. Oosoo yise ka Te Pabe'e-baa petugase mee oo netamma, “U pua'a Lazarus unu tuoeya'e.” Soo Te Pabe'e ka oo nakahoose mee unakwe, “Tooe oo ya'ese sapa, nu ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-toohakwi oo mayodakwu, o'no mu numu e nesookwugikwu, nu ka Te Naa Tooa'ana. Oo manepunnedu, umu e sopedakwatoo, nu ka yow Mu Tubetse Pabe'e-na. O'no mu numu eka poonnese mee unnekwu, ‘Soo Te Pabe'e tookwa unu pooha-ga'yoo.’ ” Soo Te Pabe'e ka Lazarus-witu nakase waha tabe mease,
yise numme pumme nakatzimodu mee netamma, “Tamme ka teepu Judea mee naneadu-kwitoosoo kodyu.”
Numme yise ka Te Pabe'e punno'o mee netamma, “Te nanumu papabe'e otuoo tupe-ma u too'e tatsagapu. U sakwa gi oetoosoo kodyupana.”
Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo, “Nu meno'o yaahoo togesoo gwetzoinnumme. Gi hee meno'o e patza-wa'ne'yoo, gisoo nu E Naa nuka tunetammakupu mamakwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee ne netamma, “Te pua'a Lazarus sukwe u'we, tamme oo-matoo mease nu saa'a oo netupoonnedooa.”
Numme oo nakatzimodu yise ka Te Pabe'e mee netamma, “Gi tookwa oosoo hownne'yoo ka sukwe uwena. Oosoo puusoo pudusoo tupoonnekoo.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka Lazarus ya'ena sopedakwadoo. Numme meeoo sokwama soo Lazarus tookwa sukwe u'we.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise besasoo oetu ne tuukwe'e, “Soo Lazarus ya'epu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee ne netamma, “Nu besa soonamme nu ka gi onona ka Lazarus ya'ehoose. O'no nu e besa pooha manena mu tzapoonnekukwu, o'no yise saa'a mu e naka'oedyukudooa. Meno'o tamme ka oo natugu-kwitoo mea'a.”
Soo nana Thomas mee naneadu, Namatu mee tuwazoo naneadu, mee ne netamma, “Tamme sakwa ka Te Pabe'e-no mea'ase, o'no sumuna tamme saa'a ka Te Pabe'e-nosoo natagoedooa.”
Ka oo Te Pabe'e-no ne petuhoogase mu numu meeoo ne tuukwe'e, “Mooasoo watsu tabe meakapu soo Lazarus ka tupe tawaga-kwi natugupuna.”
Soo Bethany ka Jerusalem tsage'yoona, ewa'yoo mu Jew numu ka Jerusalem nakwanatu kemmana mu Mary noko Martha-baa petugase, ka Bethany-wi'yoona mu netusoonakute, ka mu wannga'a ya'ese.
Mu numu ka Martha meeoo tuukwe'e, “Soo Jesus mu pua'a mooasoo oo-na kemma.” Soo Martha yise oo wegea meahoo. Soo Mary ka gi oo nakana tu nobe-kwisoo.
Soo Martha yise ka Te Pabe'e wege'owse mee oo netamma petuga, “U sakwa uga ka ne wannga'a tooesoo gwetzo'i petuse, oosoo uga gi ya'ekwu.
Soo Te Naa ka pumme u nanetzakwiya'e u nakasootuhidyina mu numu besa mayugweyakwe.”
Soo Te Pabe'e mee oo netamma, “Saa'a soo u wannga'a gwetzoise tuusootabuekwu.”
Soo Martha yise ka Te Pabe'e mee netamma, “Aha, nu oo sopedakwatoo soo teepu saa'a atasoo manekwu, no'yoona mu tuipu tuusootabuekwu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee ka Martha netamma, “Nu ka mu numu mayodakwu. Soo tooe haga tooe nuka naka'oedyukudu, too'e ya'ese sapa nu mu matuusootabuese umu ooosapa gwetzoimokwu. U haa'a puu e naka'oedyukute?”
Martha yise meeoo oo netamma, “Aha, nu u naka'oedyukute, u yow Ne Pabe'e, o'nosoo nanekemmapu.”
Soo Martha yise ka Mary-matoo mease meeoo oo watse tuukwe, “Soo Te Pabe'e mooasoo petuoose u ba'e.”
Soo Mary ka oo nakahoose, yotsekase ka Te Pabe'e-matoo meahoo.
Mooasoo ewa'yoo Jew numu petugonno ka Mary netusoonakuna. Ka Mary gi obeda yotseoose oo meahoose umu numu meeoo sokwama, “Oosoo tookwa ka tu wannga'a natugu-kwitoo meahoo.” Umu yise oo-nakwi mea'a.
Soo Mary ka Te Pabe'e-baa petugase oo-kobena meatzedose, mee ka Te Pabe'e netamma, “U sakwa uga ka o'nosoo petuoose, e Pabe'e sakwa uga gi ya'e.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka Mary tu pupua'a-no mu sakwa'e mu poonnena, tutuha mu sooyugwe.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo tutubenga, “Hano natzatugu?” Umu yise mee oo nanekwegea, “Kemmow, numme u tzapoonnekukwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise yaka.

Mu numu otuoo yise mee nana'unnegonno, “Masoo Jesus tookwa togesapa ka Lazarus unu soobedya.” Mu susumudu punno'o mee unnegonno, “Esoo Jesus puu ka gi tubootabuedu mabesaku, ka Lazarus sakwa uga tuwazoo ooosoo. Soo Lazarus uga gi ya'ekwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise tutuha soonammena, ka tupe tawaga-kwitoo ka Lazarus pukwi natugu-kwitoo mea. Ka tupe tawagana-kobena papabatse'yoo tseketadyadu tupe-ma oo nadatumapunne.

Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo, “Ka tupe sekebatoo magonnonoekwuni.” Soo Lazarus suakwu Martha yise meeoo oo netamma, “Oosoo mooasoo watsu tabeno manekapu ka mi natzatuguna. Meno'o ka sumuna oosoo suda kwanakapu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo oo netamma, “Mooasoo nu mee uga u tuukwepu, u ka tunaka'oedyukuna, o'no u ka Te Naa pooha tuyugwena poonnekwu.”
Ka tupe mu magonnonoese, soo Te Pabe'e toogoopatu poonnese meeoo nanesootuhi, “Ne Naa u nanasookwuga'e, nu ka nono'otsa u nanetzakwi'yina u e nakasootuhiyakwe.
Nu oo sopedakwadoo u ooosapa e nakasootuhidyidu. Nu meno'o yaanona u yadoo'e, o'no mu numu yaatu e naka'oedyukukwu, nu yaahoo U Besaa Tooa.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise pabatse'e ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-toohakwi mee unne, “Lazarus, yaatoo kemma.”
Soo Lazarus yise, yaatoo tsebooeke, oo tookoo no'yoona wunapu-ma nakwutoota, oo-koobadooe. Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka mu numu meeoo netamma, “Ka a nakwutootana tzahanehoo.”
Ewa'yoo mu numu Jerusalem-wi'yoona ka Mary-no kemmadu ka Te Pabe'e pooha manena poonnese oo soo'oedyukute.
Pana susumudu umu-matu gi oo soo'oedyukudu, ka mu Pharisee Te Pabe'e tumoo'oodu-matoo mease ka Te Pabe'e besa pooha tuyugwepu mu tuukwe'e.
Mu tutunehanedu-no mu Pharisee sumuhoose mee unakwe, “Soo Jesus ewa naduya pooha manekena. Ha'oo sakwa tamme oo sootunaga?

Ka meno'o gi ooka te tzodyooikute no'yoona numu sumuna oo naka'oedyuku mani petugakwu. O'no sumuna mu Roman numu moohedu umu tukwutumadu yaatoo tayase umu ka te nanesootuhi nobe, yise no'oko te nanumu manepunnena kadoo mayugwekwu.”
Sumu'yoo mu tutunehanedu pabe'e Caiaphas mee naneadu mee mu netamma, “Mu gi hemma sopedakwatoo.
Tamme sakwa ka Jesus batsa, oosoo puu sukwe sumu'yoosoo nana. Tamme puu ewa'yoo. O'no tamme no'yoona gi tuikwu.” Gi puu pumme tusooyugwena yadoo'a.
Oosoo ka mu tunehane pabe'ena, soo Te Naa pumme soonammetuguna oo yadooa tuunguna, oosoo yise meeoo, “Jesus no'oko ka mu tu nanumu-koobatoo nabatsakwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e gi ka mu tu nanumu-koobatoo suu'mu nabatsakwu, no'obatusoo numu-koobatoo nabatsakwu.
Mu Jew tutunehanedu yise oo batsakwu mee tunehane.
Soo Te Pabe'e ooonne'yoona tukena nuuyugwesapa, numme yise ka Te Pabe'e-no Ephraim mee naneadu-kwitoo me'a, onahoo sukwe hee-wanatoo.
Soo tabeba tzage'e manekena ka mu pooha tumayohoyina, o'no umu gi namayadu tukaba
ewa tukayakwe.
Ewa'yoo numu ka Jerusalem-kwitoo ewa tuka mi. Mu numu yise ka Te Pabe'e watena mee nanatubenga, “Ha'oogena soo Jesus ka ewa tukape-kwitoo kemmakwu?”
Mu tutunehanedu, mu numu meeoo netamma, “Ne tuukwe saa'a ka Jesus poonnese, o'no numme oo wutumowkwu.”

O'no tabeno mu numu ka tu tumayohope mayohoyakwe, tu tumayu'a ka tu nobe-kwitu hanekwuniyakwe.
